E0109

`+` can't compare or combine Int (a whole number) and String (text)

What

`+` can't compare or combine Int (a whole number) and String (text)

Why

The operator has no built-in rule and no user-defined `impl Type.Trait` hook for this operand pair

Fix

Use a supported operand pair, call a named method, or implement the operator's hook trait on your own type for this pair

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0109: tests/ui/E0109_literal_pieces.stderr.

Error [jet.OperatorTypeMismatch]: Text isn't joined with `+`
  --> tests/ui/E0109_literal_pieces.jet:2:12
    |
  2 |     print(("a" + 1))
    |            ^^^^^^^
 Why: There's one way to build text: interpolation (S8)
 Fix: Write the pieces inside one string: "a{1}"
